name: memostem
description: Reuse private owner-scoped knowledge and create reviewable drafts after consent.

interface.longDescription: Retrieve the signed-in owner's private knowledge and, after clear consent, create reviewable pending atomic memo or question-and-answer drafts through OAuth MCP.
capabilities: Private pending atomic memo and question-and-answer drafts
defaultPrompt: Notice one reusable idea in this conversation, name it, and ask before creating a private MemoStem draft.
Use my active MemoStem knowledge for context, then after I confirm create a concise atomic memo or question-and-answer draft.
Verify my MemoStem connection and help me reconsent if either knowledge permission is missing.
